description:
All works due to general maintenance and to lessen the area of acorn fall, elderly customer has fallen on them walking into the house, she is unsteady on her feet and has a walking aid.

T1	Ash	Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 3/4 metres. Tree above car port take protection boards and matt and lowering kit. Inspect animal made holes on stems where found. 	

T2-T3 (front grd)	Oak x 3	Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 2 metres back to previous points.

T4	Oak x 1	Fell as close to ground level as possible, poison stump and remove all arisings. Works due to over crowding of group of Oaks and to help with acorn falling on path causing a trip hazard. Pavement is also lifting directly next to this tree and itâ??s very likely to be root related. 	

T5 (front grd)	Oak x 1	Crown Reduction - Reducing the height and spread of the tree by up to 2 metres back to previous points.
